company.introduction: Sage develops software that helps small and medium-sized businesses manage accounting, payroll, people and other operational processes. Products such as Sage Intacct support financial management, while other applications serve different business sizes and requirements. Revenue comes mainly from software subscriptions and related support, creating ongoing relationships with customers who rely on the systems for daily work. Accountants and business partners also help distribute and implement its products. The company combines software development with customer service and compliance updates. Demand depends on the value customers see in automation and accurate records, while retention and the adoption of cloud services support the recurring-revenue model.

overallConfidence.methodology: Overall confidence combines press sentiment (40%), annual-report tone (35%) and emerging themes (25%).
